Method of Attack: Spearphishing using a memo pretending to come from the current president of an Azerbaijan company
HTML smuggling to deliver a password-protected archive containing a malicious .LNK file
The .LNK file executes a command to download and run an MSI installer that installs malware
Malware gathers basic computer information and sends it to a C2 server
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Windows systems of targeted management associated with an Azerbaijanian company
Attack Vector: Spearphishing email with a malicious memo
HTML smuggling technique in the memo to deliver a password-protected archive
Malicious .LNK file that downloads and executes an MSI installer
